name: IPCubed 3D Live
description: Live, full-stackup 3D view on top of the KiCad PCB editor.
description_full:
IPCubed reads the open board over the KiCad IPC API and shows a live 3D view (copper, dielectric, solder mask, silkscreen, STEP/WRL models, ViewCube) overlaid on the PCB editor. Click the '3D Live' toolbar button once, then press 3 in the PCB canvas to toggle.

BETA: use at your own risk. On the first click IPCubed asks to download its components (Qt, OpenCascade, wgpu: about 160-215 MB, once).

Requires the KiCad API: Preferences > Plugins > Enable KiCad API.
